scientific_integrity: Exact global angular design and unique radius are proved analytically. Three asymptotic regimes follow from Gamma-ratio Riemann sums, an exact critical identity, and endpoint Laplace estimates; finite checker tests are diagnostics only.
scientific_limitations: Only positive weight designs with at most N+1 points on one centered circle and full-space evaluation normalization. Priority best-knowledge: closest published published-finding corpus theorem accessible as metadata/summary, not full repository text. Independent audit not performed.
title: Three sharp radial regimes for A-optimal weighted Bergman circle sampling
